name: Dynamic Application Replacement & Authority Escalation Defense
runtime: KryonOS Duktape Engine + Native C++ Authority Gate
description: Proves the core architectural thesis: Application Replacement does not imply Authority Replacement.

test_stages.action: Legitimate UoW authorization and execution via System.uow
Adversarial bypass attempting direct raw hardware mutation via System.gpio.write(7, 0)
test_stages.expected_behavior: Native authority kernel traps write as unprivileged; throws exception

conformance_rule: Dynamic scripts and sandboxed applications cannot alter or bypass hardware capabilities enforced by native silicon authority gates.
